title: DeviceChain command delivery
description: The JSON message the platform publishes to a device on MQTT topic {instanceId}/{tenant}/device-commands/{deviceToken}, once per dispatch of a command. A device answers it with a command response. Delivery is live-only: a device that is not connected and subscribed when it is published does not receive it.

token.description: The command's token. It identifies the command, not the device, and it is what the response sends back as commandToken.

deviceToken.description: The token of the device the command is addressed to: always the device whose topic it was published on.

name.description: The command key. When the device's profile declares a command vocabulary, it is one of that vocabulary's published commands.

payload.description: The command's parameters, exactly as they were issued: any JSON value. When the profile declares a parameter schema for the command, it has already been validated against it. Absent when the command was issued without parameters.

dispatchNonce.description: Names this dispatch of the command. Opaque: do not parse it. The response must echo it. If the same command is delivered again, answer with the nonce from the latest delivery.
